name: signal-lab
description: Sketch block diagrams of radios and other signal chains, simulate them, and plot or listen anywhere along the way.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.fmt: oxlint src scripts test --fix && oxfmt src scripts test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run fmt:check && npm run typecheck && npm run deadcode && npm test
